name: Reluctant hero
description: Called to something they would rather refuse.
key_questions: What would they give up to stay out of it?|Who pulls them in anyway?

name: Mentor
description: Holds knowledge the others need and a past that cost them.
key_questions: What did they get wrong that they now teach against?|What will they not tell their student?

name: Trickster
description: Breaks the rules to show what the rules hide.
key_questions: Whose authority do they enjoy mocking?|When does the joke stop being funny?

name: Outcast
description: Pushed out of a group they still measure themselves by.
key_questions: What did they do, or what was done to them?|What would it take to go back?

name: Rival
description: Wants what the protagonist wants and may deserve it more.
key_questions: What do they respect about their rival?|Where would they refuse to cross the line?

name: Caretaker
description: Holds others together at their own expense.
key_questions: Who would fall apart without them?|What do they want that they never say?

name: Want and need
description: What they chase against what would actually help them.
key_questions: What do they believe will fix everything?|What do they need instead?

name: Wound
description: An old hurt that explains a present habit.
key_questions: What happened that they never talk about?|What do they do now to avoid feeling it again?

name: The lie they believe
description: A false belief about the world or themselves.
key_questions: What do they believe that is not true?|What would prove it wrong in front of them?

name: Turning point
description: The moment they cannot go back from.
key_questions: What choice would change them for good?|Who pays for it?
